item.content:encoded:
Okay, so I'm very very late on this, but

Did the banner image really need to be a 1920 by 829 PNG, weighing nearly 2 megabytes?
Loading this page over a cellular connection was very slow and relatively expensive.

If this image had been a JPEG encoded at 95% quality (producing no artifacting that I can detect), it would have only been about 500 kB, and if it had additionally been scaled down to a more reasonable 1024 by 442 pixels, it would have been 183 kB - just under a tenth of its current size - with no appreciable reduction in overall quality.

I understand that it probably seems a bit excessively nitpicky to complain about this (and test the results of compressing the image, just to make the point) - but I really think that appropriate image sizing is an important courtesy. Much of the world is still stuck with slow, costly cellular connections as their only means of accessing the web, and gigantic images make this site - which is otherwise quite lightweight, for the most part - far more painful to use.

It probably doesn't matter if the image's size is reduced now, with the contest long over, but I do hope this will at least be considered in the future.

item.content:encoded:
Per the directions:

Post your entry to the site with the url '5000contest<yourusername>' with your site user name in place of <yourusername.> For example, if a user named TroyL were to post an entry it would have the url 5000contesttroyl. This page must be posted by you (or, if it is a collaboration, one of the partners). Add the tag "5000" to your entry so it shows up on this page.

If you're unsure of how to create a new page with a certain url, you can use the "New Page (Advanced)" widget at the bottom of this page: http://www.scp-wiki.net/contribute

item.title: Re: Would first ever posts be allowed?
item.content:encoded:
Yeah, you're allowed to enter (though I strongly recommend getting conceptual critique and also draft critique before posting!! The How To Write An SCP Guide covers this process in detail).

The top 5 slot selections is the five slots you'd want your contest entry moved to under the assumption that you didn't win the contest, and not the top 5 rated pages you've written.

item.content:encoded:
+ show block
– hide block

[I had a large cannon in mind (20 skips) but none fit the "mystery" part. So i did the most reasonable thing possible:
-Pick the most standalone skip (all of them would be tied in someway. Be it references or their discovery) .
-Destroy its previous connections with the others.
-Add something that makes it "mysterious".
-since the timeline is all f*cked now, unf*ck it.
-give it new connections.
-and take twice as much time to write it,

All of this aside: Thank god this contest was announced. It made a Meh standalone skip into a more complex spoopy skip. ]
